Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.numerics

Class DirectionalPhaseFaceFlux

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.numerics.DirectionalPhaseFaceFlux
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class DirectionalPhaseFaceFlux extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable directional decomposition of one phase's conservative face transport.

Forward and reverse mass flows are nonnegative and satisfy signedMass = forward - reverse. Advective momentum is assigned to the same directional donor as mass; pressure traction is retained separately. Donor mass and momentum are conservative quantities per unit pipe length. This is the transactional free-flux data required by a later mixed complementarity solve; this value object does not alter or limit transport.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

  • Constructor Details

    • DirectionalPhaseFaceFlux

      public DirectionalPhaseFaceFlux(double signedMassFlowKgPerSecond, double advectiveMomentumN, double pressureTractionN, double leftDonorMassKgPerM, double rightDonorMassKgPerM, double leftDonorMomentumKgPerSecond, double rightDonorMomentumKgPerSecond)
      Build an exact directional representation of a signed face flux.
      Parameters:
      signedMassFlowKgPerSecond - signed mass flow, positive from left to right
      advectiveMomentumN - signed-mass times donor velocity, excluding pressure traction
      pressureTractionN - phase pressure traction at the face
      leftDonorMassKgPerM - left cell phase mass per length
      rightDonorMassKgPerM - right cell phase mass per length
      leftDonorMomentumKgPerSecond - left cell phase momentum per length
      rightDonorMomentumKgPerSecond - right cell phase momentum per length
